# beatLabs

> Dubai-based independent app group (BeatLabs FZE LLC) building independent app brands — each with its own name, domain, and identity.

beatLabs is the holding entity behind a portfolio of independent digital brands. Each brand operates autonomously with its own identity, audience, and business model.

## Apps

- [Nibango](https://nibango.com) — Peer-to-peer second-hand marketplace for the Gulf. Six categories, four pricing models, zero commissions. Launching.
- [Curb](https://getcurbapp.com) — Subscription tracker for iOS and Android. No bank access, one-time Pro purchase. Live.
- [Raved](https://raved.app) — An inbox for recommendations: save every song, movie, place, and tip your friends send you. Launching.
- Epiloq — Track shows, movies, comics, and books in one place. In development.
- TimeUp — Focus blocks and deep work sessions for iOS. In development.
- Blab — Social app of daily micro-challenges: answer in your mode, inside worlds that get your context. iOS, Spanish first. Launching.

## Web & Creative

- [TrueLoveCreative](https://truelovecreative.es) — Brand identity and creative studio.
- [Estrela.photo](https://estrela.photo) — Portraits, events and visual stories.
